transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I keep going over the same worries about getting some detail wrong in my project, and it’s crowding out everything else in my day. I just can't seem to quiet my mind, and it's starting to feel completely unmanageable.
When you have these worries about getting details wrong, do you feel driven to repeatedly check your work or perform certain routines to make sure everything is perfect?

Yes, I feel an overwhelming urge to do these repetitive routines just to quiet the anxiety. I’ll re-read the same paragraph in my grant proposal or re-measure a label's placement over and over, sometimes whispering the facts under my breath like a checklist until it feels "just right." It's exhausting, but I just can't seem to stop myself.
Apart from these specific worries about your work details, do you also experience constant, excessive worry about many other areas of your life, such as your health, family, or finances?

No, I don't really worry about those other areas like my health, family, or finances. My anxiety is almost entirely focused on the details and accuracy of this art project, and making sure I don't get anything wrong.
On average, how much time do you spend each day carrying out these repetitive checking routines or dealing with these persistent thoughts?

Honestly, it feels like it takes up almost my entire day, with the mental loops running constantly even when I’m trying to eat dinner or watch TV. The repetitive checking and re-reading eat up so many hours that I'm missing work deadlines and skipping church and guild events just to keep up.
Do you generally feel that these worries and the need to keep checking things are excessive or unreasonable, even though you feel unable to stop them?

Yes, I absolutely know they are excessive and unreasonable. Even though I know I've already checked everything a dozen times and nothing new will change, I still feel this uncontrollable urge to keep doing it just to quiet the anxiety. It's definitely crossed the line from being conscientious to being completely unmanageable.
Did these thoughts and checking behaviors start or get worse after you began taking any new medications, using substances, or experiencing a medical illness?

No, I haven't started any new medications or used any recreational substances at all. I also haven't had any recent illnesses or changes in my physical health. This all just seemed to build up on its own as the pressure of the project increased.
